verdict.strongest_positive_evidence: On the exact A=0,B=2 slice the ramification critical locus is a degree-14 curve, so the isolated-cA analysis is false there; combined with accepted corank-two data and h3=h4=0 this is the Morse-Bott shape.  Modular fold samples at p=67 find singular cubics only rarely on simple folds.  Neither statement closes the global mod-3 gate by itself.
